gate.reason: The owner sequenced FG Mandor after the active integration block is stable.

payroll_installment_derivation.critical_rule: These routines are generated from accepted Native payroll definitions at bundle time. Do not hand-edit a generated final-payment body or bypass its predecessor digest guards.

sales_form.change_boundary: Add Toko/Mandor category and explicit contractor selection while retaining customer_id as the Native sale/AR identity.

sales_transport.change_boundary: Keep useProductionMutation and erp_cp7_save_sale_v1 recovery/idempotency behavior.

sales_contract.change_boundary: Expose explicit buyer category and contractor identity without weakening closed response parsing.

payroll_host.change_boundary: Mount the invoice-card allocation panel on the exact selected payroll and contractor.

source_card_pattern.reuse_only: Reuse its explicit contractor binding, cards, draft-week allocation, stale-read retirement and useProductionMutation pattern; do not turn an FG invoice into a cash advance.

final_payment_surface.change_boundary: Display the already-approved net payable; do not settle invoice AR on a partial cash installment.

critical_accounting_binding.observed_native_behavior: erp.post_payroll_payment currently totals every deduction other than MATERIAL_KASBON and CASH_ADVANCE into PAYROLL_OTHER_DEDUCTION and credits OTHER_INCOME.
critical_accounting_binding.required_FG_behavior: FG invoice deductions must be excluded from that generic total and settled exactly once through a dedicated noncash Dr CONTRACTOR_PAYABLE / Cr AR_CUSTOMER journal linked to the same sale invoice.
critical_accounting_binding.cash_behavior: The payroll cash or bank journal remains the approved net amount only.
critical_accounting_binding.sales_payment_behavior: Do not create erp.sales_payments because that table represents real cash sources.
critical_accounting_binding.stock_HPP_behavior: erp.post_sale remains the single owner of sale posting, FG movement and COGS; payroll settlement creates no second stock, revenue or COGS effect.

required_command_boundaries: A protected contractor-to-customer-account link and sale-contractor sidecar; no name matching.
A dedicated allocation command with request UUID, exact payroll row_version/review token and exact sale review token.
Locks and revalidation over the payroll, contractor identity, sorted sale headers, allocations and account mappings before effects.
Draft allocation only reserves capacity; invoice AR changes only on the final PAID transition.
Individual final-payment reversal reopens the same settlement and keeps the allocation reserved; whole payroll reversal releases it.
Invoice return, payment or correction that changes open balance retires review and blocks stale settlement.
required_future_tests_not_run_here: Manual week choice and partial carry-forward
300000 invoice against 2000000 payroll produces 1700000 cash out and 300000 AR settlement
Final installment settles once while earlier installments leave invoice AR unchanged
Cancellation, individual reversal and whole reversal
Invoice balance change before payroll payment
Exact replay, changed-intent refusal, double click and two-tab collision
